question: List the personal details and the address type descriptions of all the students.
schema:
tenant=spider_cre_Students_Information_Systems
tables:
  - Achievements
      achievement_id: int — achievement id
      achievement_type_code: str — achievement type code
      student_id: int — student id
      date_achievement: int — date achievement
      achievement_details: str — achievement details
      other_details: str — other details
  - Addresses
      address_id: int — address id
      address_details: str — address details
  - Behaviour_Monitoring
      behaviour_monitoring_id: int — behaviour monitoring id
      student_id: int — student id
      behaviour_monitoring_details: str — behaviour monitoring details
  - Classes
      class_id: int — class id
      student_id: int — student id
      teacher_id: int — teacher id
      class_details: str — class details
  - Detention
      detention_id: int — detention id
      detention_type_code: str — detention type code
      student_id: int — student id
      datetime_detention_start: str — datetime detention start
      datetime_detention_end: str — datetime detention end
      detention_summary: str — detention summary
      other_details: str — other details
  - Ref_Achievement_Type
      achievement_type_code: str — achievement type code
      achievement_type_description: str — achievement type description
  - Ref_Address_Types
      address_type_code: str — address type code
      address_type_description: str — address type description
  - Ref_Detention_Type
      detention_type_code: str — detention type code
      detention_type_description: str — detention type description
  - Ref_Event_Types
      event_type_code: str — event type code
      event_type_description: str — event type description
  - Student_Events
      event_id: int — event id
      event_type_code: str — event type code
      student_id: int — student id
      event_date: str — event date
      other_details: str — other details
  - Student_Loans
      student_loan_id: int — student loan id
      student_id: int — student id
      date_of_loan: str — date of loan
      amount_of_loan: float — amount of loan
      other_details: str — other details
  - Students
      student_id: int — student id
      bio_data: str — bio data
      student_details: str — student details
  - Students_Addresses
      student_address_id: int — student address id
      address_id: int — address id
      address_type_code: str — address type code
      student_id: int — student id
      date_from: str — date from
      date_to: str — date to
  - Teachers
      teacher_id: int — teacher id
      teacher_details: str — teacher details
  - Transcripts
      transcript_id: int — transcript id
      student_id: int — student id
      date_of_transcript: str — date of transcript
      transcript_details: str — transcript details
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Transcripts.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Behaviour_Monitoring.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Student_Events.event_type_code → Ref_Event_Types.event_type_code
  - Student_Events.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Student_Loans.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Classes.teacher_id → Teachers.teacher_id
  - Classes.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Students_Addresses.address_type_code → Ref_Address_Types.address_type_code
  - Students_Addresses.address_id → Addresses.address_id
  - Students_Addresses.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Detention.detention_type_code → Ref_Detention_Type.detention_type_code
  - Detention.student_id → Students.student_id
  - Achievements.achievement_type_code → Ref_Achievement_Type.achievement_type_code
  - Achievements.student_id → Students.student_id
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.student_details ,  T3.address_type_description FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Students_Addresses AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Ref_Address_Types AS T3 ON T2.address_type_code  =  T3.address_type_code
system_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "students"."bio_data" AS "bio_data", "ref_address_types"."address_type_description" AS "address_type_description" FROM "Students" AS "students" JOIN "Students_Addresses" AS "students_addresses" ON "students"."student_id" = "students_addresses"."student_id" JOIN "Ref_Address_Types" AS "ref_address_types" ON "students_addresses"."address_type_code" = "ref_address_types"."address_type_code" LIMIT 10000

question: Find the number of papers published in different conferences each year.
schema:
tenant=spider_aan_1
tables:
  - Affiliation
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
      name: str
      address: str
  - Author
      author_id: int — author id
      name: str
      email: str
  - Author_list
      paper_id: str — paper id
      author_id: int — author id
      affiliation_id: int — affiliation id
  - Citation
      paper_id: str — paper id
      cited_paper_id: str — cited paper id
  - Paper
      paper_id: str — paper id
      title: str
      venue: str
      year: int
relationships (many → one; joins are added automatically):
  - Author_list.affiliation_id → Affiliation.affiliation_id
  - Author_list.author_id → Author.author_id
  - Author_list.paper_id → Paper.paper_id
  - Citation.cited_paper_id → Paper.paper_id
  - Citation.paper_id → Paper.paper_id
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  venue ,  YEAR FROM Paper GROUP BY venue ,  YEAR
